definition_en: extra hours worked beyond the normal working time
example_en: She earns extra money by working overtime on weekends.
example_id: Dia mendapat uang tambahan dengan lembur pada akhir pekan.

definition_en: a short written summary of your education and work experience
example_en: He sent his resume to five companies last week.
example_id: Dia mengirim daftar riwayat hidupnya ke lima perusahaan minggu lalu.

definition_en: to make something happen later than planned
example_en: Bad weather delayed our flight by three hours.
example_id: Cuaca buruk menunda penerbangan kami selama tiga jam.

definition_en: a narrow passage between rows of seats on a plane or bus
example_en: I prefer an aisle seat so I can walk around easily.
example_id: Saya lebih suka kursi lorong agar mudah berjalan-jalan.

definition_en: money given to a student to help pay for their studies
example_en: She won a scholarship to study medicine abroad.
example_id: Dia memenangkan beasiswa untuk belajar kedokteran di luar negeri.

definition_en: one of two periods into which a school year is divided
example_en: Final exams take place at the end of each semester.
example_id: Ujian akhir diadakan pada setiap akhir semester.

definition_en: to copy a file from the internet onto your device
example_en: You can download the app for free from the store.
example_id: Kamu bisa mengunduh aplikasi itu gratis dari toko aplikasi.

definition_en: a device that stores energy to power phones and laptops
example_en: My phone battery dies quickly in cold weather.
example_id: Baterai ponsel saya cepat habis saat cuaca dingin.

definition_en: a large amount of water covering land that is usually dry
example_en: Heavy rain caused a flood in the northern villages.
example_id: Hujan deras menyebabkan banjir di desa-desa utara.

definition_en: the usual weather conditions of a place over a long time
example_en: The island has a warm and wet climate all year.
example_id: Pulau itu beriklim hangat dan lembap sepanjang tahun.

definition_en: a sign in the body that shows you may be ill
example_en: A high temperature is a common symptom of the flu.
example_id: Suhu tubuh tinggi adalah gejala umum flu.

definition_en: a shop where medicines are prepared and sold
example_en: You can buy vitamins at the pharmacy near the hospital.
example_id: Kamu bisa membeli vitamin di apotek dekat rumah sakit.
